name: Geszteréd (Hungary)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, yellow and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gesztered: a blue and green shield with ears of grain and a fish, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling, above a yellow scroll inscribed GESZTERÉD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Gesztered arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
